Lee Sin

Support Weird but works

Insec Support Lee Sin

How to play this build

Drop a ward in a bush and dash (W) for a surprise engage; chain Q→Q to stick to the target. The masterstroke is the insec ult: kick the enemy carry straight into your team. It takes practice but decides fights.

Skill order

Max priority:

E Tempestad / Mutilar → Q Onda Sónica / Golpe Resonante → W Salvaguarda / Voluntad de Hierro

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Tempest (E) for the slow that secures the gank and AoE damage; Q second, your engage. As support you don't farm with Q.

Items and what they do

  1. Sightstone Support item granting free ward charges to control vision.
  2. Iceborn Gauntlet Armor, mana and CDR; after a spell, your attack deals AoE damage and slows (upgraded Sheen).
  3. Frozen Mallet Lots of health and some AD; your auto-attacks slow the target (permaslow).
  4. Mercury's Treads Boots with MR and tenacity (reduced CC duration).
  5. Randuin's Omen Health and armor; active AoE slow that also cuts attackers' attack speed.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
0/9/21 — Defense/Utility
Why this page
0/9/21 gives durability and utility to engage and peel as a support.
